sections.heading: Description
sections.content: The Communication Strategy is aligned with the overall project strategy and comprises the definition of stakeholder groups, communication scope, mission, vision and concrete communication measures. It provides leading-edge, practical communication tools and services that deliver clearly articulated, targeted and timely messages.

sections.heading: Business Value
sections.content: Improves clarity and reduces uncertainty. Enhances stakeholder trust and confidence. Supports timely and relevant information sharing. Increases change adoption and participation. Strengthens organizational alignment and morale.
